items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Desmond was tall and slim? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. And then there was a younger brother... [INTERVIEWER] Desmond was a dancer? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, he was with the Chocolateers...

ctx.x: Well Mosby was about the same height. He was rotund.
Yeah. And then there was a younger brother, I forget his name. He was a teenager at that time.
